title: A sucker meets a surface
hook: A soft structure can form a grip.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: The first panel shows a sucker away from a surface. In the second the rim contacts it, forming a seal. An octopus can use muscular suckers to grip; this sketch omits the detailed pressure changes and does not measure grip strength.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: In a simplified octopus sucker model, which condition helps the sucker attach to a smooth surface?
